cost_findings.predict_entry: public_live_obligation_communication_projection.predict calls context.revalidate(supplied_context), then initial_projection_bundle calls revalidate on the same object again. Both rerun the complete initial source/digest/coverage/state guard and reconstruct/copy a SuppliedContext.
cost_findings.per_candidate_setup: Projection constructors deep-copy the initial bundle and actions, build current nodes/edges/trays/queues/calendars and compute public service-aware potential. Future collection guards also perform complete native-shaped source checks.
cost_findings.verifier_only_cost: The conformance worker additionally validates both initial owners and rebuilds each actual later context after prediction. Those checks are offline target validation and remain charged to the audit, but they are not all repeated online model calls.
cost_findings.measurement_limit: Source inspection identifies repeated work, not its measured exclusive duration. Existing133.7844712s/73 model total includes initial validation, dynamic simulation and predicted message guards; no finer cost attribution was recorded.
cost_findings.previous_negatives: Do not import the slower prefix clone, static factory or quiet-tail candidates. This plan first removes duplicate same-request input verification only, leaving all dynamic event and source guards intact.

authority_and_invalidation.pure_context: A request context is supplied-data computation only; it cannot certify actual source origin, current state, an atomic capture cut or physical protection.
authority_and_invalidation.future_online_adapter: The controller must independently establish exact NativeCollected/NativeCollectionAttempt origin, LocalTransport/session/admission and immutable own ledger. The pure worker receives only the snapshot data; no native handle/capability is serialized or reconstructed.
authority_and_invalidation.scope: One accepted owner decision and one immutable collection snapshot. A new observation/message, source pair, physical action/submission, native clock advance, owner admission or retry/recollection creates a new context. Do not reuse it across first-return and first-reuse phases.
authority_and_invalidation.before_execution: After search, the actual adapter must still reread/revalidate the deciding owner's current job/generation/traversal/uncommitted suffix, current action ledger, available receiving permission and exact wire deadline. A stale context is never an action permission.
authority_and_invalidation.mutation: Caller changes to supplied dictionaries or returned results must not mutate the internal snapshot or another candidate. Such edits do not count as a fresh observed snapshot. Closed current-origin guards remain outside this pure caching mechanism.

required_pure_gates: Exact32 domain and action order retained; malformed/unsupported contexts return unknown for the full declared denominator.

Recomputed-digest future facts, missing/changed completion prefix, owner/gen/traversal mismatch, pending actions, stale expiry and current-owner changes are still rejected at context creation or actual adapter boundary.
Mutate caller input, returned snapshot/action/result and candidate1 dynamic queues/ACKs; candidate2 and the source snapshot remain unchanged, including internal alias expectations.

rolling_method_gap.minimum_next_information_gate: Bind the actual successful later collections to same-prefix action families: at A first-return, the initial route and E window are already fixed while4 return/later combinations remain; at B first-reuse, the return is already issued while2 later preferences remain. Confirm the available actual context/prefix equality before treating those old branches as retrospective same-state suffix comparisons.
rolling_method_gap.suffix_predictor_requirement: A separate continuation predictor must reconstruct or seed all observed current service/entry/hold/Storage states, prior issued actions, completed prefix and receiving occupancy. It must also justify any reused edge-headway/calendar/FIFO history from lawful retained facts; unsupported history remains unknown. No native checkpoint/fork, peer private view or future outcome may initialize it.

rolling_method_gap.conformance_scope: Chosen continuation equality is a retrospective conditional model check, not an independently bounded counterfactual error certificate or a future native protection guarantee. Actual prospective terminal evidence remains required.
